findings.title: Session Detail chart and timeline show $0 cost
findings.problem: For a session with cost_available false, Session Detail still renders confirmed zero money outside the header metric: the 'Token & cost growth' chart accumulates e.cost_usd (0.0 from pricer.price for an unpriced model, cli_analytics_handler.py:1095) into a flat $0 cost line, and SessionTimeline.tsx:129/182 formats dispatch cost_usd 0 as $0.00. Only the Cost and Cache-read cost metric cards were switched to SessionCostValue.
findings.impact: The same Session Detail page shows the cost as unknown in the header while its chart and timeline assert $0.00, contradicting the task's expected behavior (mark cost unknown instead of a confirmed $0.00) on a surface inside the approved Session Detail scope.
findings.recommendation: In Session Detail, when session.cost_available === false, hide the cost series of the 'Token & cost growth' chart (or render it as unknown) and pass cost_available into SessionTimeline so dispatch cost (SessionTimeline.tsx:129 tooltip and :182 cell) renders ABSENT_VALUE_MARKER instead of formatCliAnalyticsCost(0). Add SessionBody tests for an unknown-cost session.

fix.change: SessionBody drops the growth chart's cost series and axis when cost_available is false and passes costAvailable to SessionTimeline, which shows ABSENT_VALUE_MARKER instead of a dispatch's $0.00 cost in the row tooltip and the detail panel
fix.test: SessionBody.test.tsx > SessionBody chart and timeline cost (EPMCDME-16522)

findings.title: Unpriced names never match normalized row models
findings.problem: withRowUnpricedModels keeps metadata.unpriced_models entries only when models.has(name), where models comes from row.model_name. The backend fills unpriced with raw model keys (session_money.py:100 prices by the raw c.model_name, e.g. bedrock/converse/eu.anthropic.<model>-v1:0), while row.model_name is the comma-joined normalize_model() output (cli_analytics_handler.py:434). Any model whose raw name differs from its normalized form never matches.
findings.impact: In the sessions list a partly priced session using a Bedrock-wrapped/prefixed unpriced model shows a plain dollar amount with no understated marker, and a fully unknown row gets the generic 'no price for this model' tooltip; the understated-cost marker the task requires silently disappears for wrapped model names.
findings.recommendation: Normalize both sides before matching in withRowUnpricedModels: port normalize_model (strip ^(bedrock/)?(converse|invoke)/, a ^([a-z0-9-]+\.)?anthropic\. prefix, and a -vN:N tag after an 8-digit date) into the UI and test models.has(normalize(name)); keep the API unchanged. Add a store test with a Bedrock-wrapped unpriced name on a multi-model row.

fix.change: the store ports normalize_model (normalizeModelName) and withRowUnpricedModels compares normalized names on both sides; unpriced_models keeps the raw names and the API is unchanged
fix.test: cliAnalytics.test.ts > fetchSessions matches a Bedrock-wrapped unpriced name to the normalized row model
